vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is a division by zero in the _takeLiquidity function. When all fee parameters (liquidityFeeonBuy, liquidityFeeonSell, burnFeeOnBuy, burnFeeOnSell) are set to zero, the denominator becomes zero, causing a revert on division. This can be triggered by the owner setting all these fees to zero via setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions, then performing a transfer that triggers fee calculation.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner to set all relevant fees to zero. 2. Trigger a transfer that will call _takeLiquidity with tLiquidity > 0, causing the division by zero revert.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 2. Call setBuyFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) to set buy fees to zero. 3. Call setSellFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) to set sell fees to zero. 4. Ensure trading is enabled (if not already). 5. Perform a transfer that will trigger fee calculation (e.g., transfer to the uniswap pair to trigger sell fees). 6. The transfer should revert due to division by zero in _takeLiquidity.
